reference_policy: Reuse original archived E/S/G/R rows without rerunning reference learning. R comparisons are post hoc.
values: One r and ir for every live classifier and every maze goal. Policy q*r*num, bootstrap max q*r over change-anticipating next-match rules, rewards and first-decision profiles use the current/drawn goal. Shared r and ir have no learning role.
initialization: Each new entry takes the base creation values: covering r=0.0 and ir=initial_ir; general initial_r and initial_ir; ALP copies all parent r/ir entries. Update flags reset on creation. An undrawn goal keeps its start or inherited values.
transition_model: Core ALP primitives, q, marks, numerosity, subsumption and covering are unchanged. Every original, fallback and copy receives a full model update. GA is rejected. No restore path exists.
randomness: Policy stream1 and sampler stream7 retain the base construction; no additional random stream.
counters: Every row records cumulative macroclassifier-goal reward writes by original/relabeled origin, live entries updated at least once during their own lifetime, and live classifier-goal pairs. ALP inheritance does not itself count as a reward update; removal drops live entries.
scientific_scope: Departs from Butz ACS2 reinforcement learning: no value generalization across goals, with a shared transition model.

success.primary: Equal-weight mean of all registered checkpoint success values within each seed.
success.interaction: (S+1-S)-(E+1-E), calculated within each seed before the interval.

analysis.pooling: Concatenate training, validation and test, retain their recorded pair weights and normalize by total mass. Blocks have equal mass even with unequal sizes.
analysis.F: Weighted optimal first-action share among nonfallback decisions.
analysis.F_mod: Weighted optimality of the within-start modal action among nonfallback decisions; lowest action index breaks modal ties.
analysis.estimate_minus_q: Mean first-action estimate minus capped Q* for the chosen action, including fallbacks.
analysis.estimate_above_v: Weighted share with binary64 estimate strictly greater than capped V*, among nonfallback decisions.
analysis.within_start_slope: Weighted within-start covariance(estimate,Q*) divided by weighted within-start variance(Q*), including fallbacks.
analysis.within_start_sd_estimate: Square root of weighted within-start estimate variance divided by total pair weight, including fallbacks.
analysis.intervals: Pair all arms by seed first. Marginal 95% t(19) and t(4), no multiplicity correction. Undefined seed metrics invalidate the interval; never drop or impute.

verdicts.signs: A+ counts ci_low > 0; A- counts ci_high < 0. Touching zero counts neither.

interaction.name: copies gain more from per-goal values
copies gain less from per-goal values

analysis.mechanism_rule: Separately for S+1-S and E+1-E, at least three of Maze4--7 have strictly positive intervals for BOTH within_start_slope and F_mod on the same maze.
analysis.post_hoc: Every other comparison, including every comparison with ACS2 or R, is post hoc.

forecast.expected_rule: Nineteen copies of each measured seed42 CPUTimeRAW; conservatively retain per-pair overhead for compact runs.
forecast.hard_rule: max(3,ceil((2*collector wall seconds+60)/60)) per arm-maze cell; reserve each array largest cell limit for every element.
forecast.limitation: One cost seed does not bound seed variance. All attempts, pilot, spent allocations, remaining reservations and new hard limits must fit the separately approved cumulative CPU-hour limit.

execution.tooling: Study-local adapters compose frozen experiments/grid collection, node guards, budget, accounting and artifact checks without changing protected grid modules.
execution.grouping: One 24-job per-pair array and three 30-job compact arrays per arm. At most two streams and forty running jobs.
execution.admission: Re-derive manifests before every sbatch; shared grant, expanded queue, scheduler test-only, node guards and STOP. All attempts, spent allocations, reservations and new hard limits within the approved cumulative CPU-hour limit.
execution.accounting: CPUTimeRAW allocation CPU-seconds, sacct deduplicated by JobIDRaw. Two independently checksum-verified archive copies.

stage2_deliverables: registered paired contrasts, separate verdicts and joint mechanism rules
F and F_mod training curves for both new arms and their bases
authorization: Stage1 ends after this single plan with its forecast and the external report. No seed beyond42 without explicit stage2 approval of these plan bytes and a CPU-hour limit.
